message.text:
**The plan: one chat, the same code on every surface.** Today the phone ✦ sheet runs on the fast/smart pair, but the ☰ drawer and the card sidebar still use the old single assistant with a model chooser. I'm moving the sheet's wiring into one module, `chat(el, {path, card})`, and every surface will call it.

**First, your live bug:** messages that vanish from the sidebar after they arrive, and a session that doesn't show in Sessions.

**The order, one small merge at a time.** Each merge gets shots at 400 and 1920 on every surface.
1. The chat module, lifted out of the sheet (no visible change).
2. The ☰ drawer and the card sidebar use it; the model chooser goes; the font becomes Montserrat.
3. /api/page-ai feeds the pair; the old per-card assistant retires.
4. The phone sheet resizes and collapses to one line.
5. The dev bar's chat mode uses it.
6. One page that shows the chat live on each surface.

**What could break:** the phone sheet you use. Every merge re-shoots it before landing, and each one can be undone by itself. The full plan is in [plan.md](/framework/ai/2026-09-30/one-dictation-system/plan.md).

**The vanishing messages are fixed on the branch; the merge comes after four review fixes.** The ✦ sheet and the ☰ drawer now use one chat, and it redraws the whole conversation every time it opens. It survives a card switch, a reopen and a reload. Your 16:33 exchange shows up again: ![](/framework/ai/2026-09-30/one-dictation/minion-chat/shots/drawer-ai-card-1920.png)

Before this merge: the fresh review found a leak and a font workaround, and both are being fixed now. The card page's own chat is moving onto the same component in parallel, and the orange border goes with it. The old sheet and drawer code stays only as a v1 you can switch back to; nothing uses it by default.

Merge 1 has landed (5ccef5eb). The ✦ sheet, the ☰ drawer's AI tab and the card's own sidebar now all use the one chat, [ux/Dictate](/framework/ux/Dictate/). Its messages come back after a reload or navigation, the model chooser is gone, the orange border is gone, and the font is Montserrat everywhere.

![The ☰ AI tab at 3440, after the merge](/framework/ai/2026-09-30/one-dictation/shots/after-drawer-ai-3440.png)

Before: [the old drawer](/framework/ai/2026-09-30/one-dictation/shots/before-drawer-ai-3440.png) · the card sidebar: [1920](/framework/ai/2026-09-30/one-dictation/shots/after-card-1920.png), [400](/framework/ai/2026-09-30/one-dictation/shots/after-card-400.png).

Your card prompts and page-ai now feed the same pair. It goes live after the Servex restart.

Next: bigger text at wide screens, the phone sheet collapsing to one line, the card in nav events plus pause events, the dev bar, and one page showing every surface. The old versions stay reachable but are no longer the default.

Merge 2 has landed (a77bb94e). All four surfaces now use the one chat, including the dev bar and the Live card. The bubbles have their icons back, code in replies renders instead of showing raw backticks, the text is full size at wide screens, and the card chat has one frame.

![The card's chat at 1920](/framework/ai/2026-09-30/one-dictation/minion-polish/shots/card-sidebar-1920.png)

On the phone, dragging the ✦ sheet down now leaves just the one-line box: [shot](/framework/ai/2026-09-30/one-dictation/minion-polish/shots/sheet-collapsed-400.png).

Next: the card in nav events and the pause events, then one page showing every surface.

The last two steps start after the weekly limit resets at 10 PM. They are the nav and pause events that tell the assistant which card you were on, and one page that shows the chat on every surface. The weekly limit is at 98%, and the brief is ready.

Push-to-talk's "two sends per sentence" isn't a real bug. Its test typed the same line into two chat boxes by hand, so it always counts two. Push-to-talk only turns on its own mic. You'd get two sends only if the page's own chat mic were also on while you hold the button. A small guard for that is queued until usage is back under pace. Until then it stays off by default: turn it on in Settings → Push-to-talk.
